Latency/throughput targets: sub-200ms token latency for assistant interactions during peaked ops (typical concurrent sessions 30-50), embeddings batch throughput ~20k docs/day; cost sensitivity secondary to compliance.
Model preferences: enterprise-vetted open encoder + private LLM (customer prefers quantized 16-bit or INT8 variants). Wants model pinning and automatic fallback to smaller verified model under load.
